subject: general
question: In _____, the Life Insurance sector was nationalised and the Life Insurance Corporation came into existence in the same year.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1956**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3594069eb4eac3d559af7c626aabe4ee4145967932cf8ad78e35476f134a4b8.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Parliament of India** passed the **Life Insurance Corporation Act** on **19 June 1956**, which paved the way for the nationalization of the life insurance industry.
 
• The **Life Insurance Corporation of India (LIC)** was formally established on **1 September 1956**, integrating the business of over **245 Indian and foreign insurers** and provident societies.
 
• The nationalization was motivated by the need to protect the interests of policyholders from the mismanagement of private companies and to channel **domestic savings** into **nation-building** projects.
 
• The move ensured that **life insurance** services were extended to rural areas and the economically backward classes, fulfilling the social objective of providing **financial security** to the masses.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3e20068b61817b168623bbf4377a66602deb382bfb1e34ae29a5e35078dcefcb.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Evolution of Insurance in India**:

 
 
• **1949**: This year is historically significant for the **nationalization of the Reserve Bank of India (RBI)**, effective from **1 January 1949**, transforming it from a private shareholders' bank to a state-owned institution.
 
• **1951**: This year marked the launch of India's **First Five-Year Plan**, focusing on the development of the agricultural sector and price stability.
 
• **1961**: The **Income Tax Act, 1961** was enacted during this year, which continues to serve as the fundamental statute for **tax administration** in India.
 
• **LIC Governance**: LIC is headquartered in **Mumbai** and operates under the administrative control of the **Ministry of Finance**. Its motto, '**Yogakshemam Vahamyaham**' (Your welfare is my responsibility), is derived from the **Bhagavad Gita**.
 
• **General Insurance Nationalization**: While life insurance was nationalized in 1956, the **General Insurance** business was later nationalized in **1972** through the General Insurance Business (Nationalisation) Act.
